> `cwcli init` can now build from a custom Frappe fork instead of the default `frappe/frappe`, and a private fork authenticates automatically.

### New Features

* `cwcli init --frappe-url <url>` builds the bench from a custom Frappe repository instead of the default `frappe/frappe`.
Pair it with the existing `--frappe-branch` to check out a specific branch on that fork.
Omitting `--frappe-url` builds the default repo exactly as before.
* A private fork passed to `--frappe-url` now authenticates automatically through cwcli's git credential bridge, the same way private app fetches already do, so `bench init` can clone it with no extra setup on your part.
